                            NEW YORK STATE SENATE





                                     THE

                             STENOGRAPHIC RECORD









                              ALBANY, NEW YORK

                              January 16, 1999

                                 10:00 a.m.





                               REGULAR SESSION







                 SENATOR JOSEPH L. BRUNO, Acting President

                 STEVEN M. BOGGESS, Secretary













                                                            70



                         ACTING PRESIDENT BRUNO:    The Senate

                 will come to order.

                         The Secretary will begin by reading

                 the Journal.

                         THE SECRETARY:    In Senate, Friday,

                 January 15, 1999.  The Senate met pursuant to

                 adjournment.  The Journal of Thursday,

                 January 14, 1999, was read and approved.  On

                 motion, the Senate adjourned.

                         ACTING PRESIDENT BRUNO:    Hearing no

                 objection, the Journal will stand approved as

                 read.

                         The order of business:

                         Presentation of petitions.

                         Messages from the Assembly.

                         Messages from the Governor.

                         Reports of standing committees.

                         Reports of select committees.

                         Communications and reports from state

                 officers.

                         Motions and resolutions.

                         Calendar.

                         Special orders.

                         Committee notices.

                         There being no further business to





                                                            71



                 come before the Senate, we'll stand

                 adjourned.

                         (Whereupon, at 10:05 a.m., the Senate

                 adjourned.)
